questions.question: Dr. REDA, now a national reference in dental photography, is invited to an international congress. What message should he convey?
options: Dental photography is a model of clinical excellence
Dental photography is reserved for specialists
questions.explanation: Dr. REDA explains: 'Dental photography is a model of clinical excellence.' Dr. RACHID: 'I am proud of you.'

questions.question: Dr. RACHID must create a foundation to promote dental photography. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. RACHID explains: 'Promoting excellence in dental photography is essential for the future of the profession.' Dr. REDA: 'I will support this foundation.'

questions.question: Dr. REDA must write a reference work on dental photography. What is the central message?
options: Dental photography is an exact science
Dental photography is an art that combines technique and clinical practice
questions.explanation: Dr. REDA explains: 'Dental photography is an art that combines technique and clinical practice.' Dr. RACHID: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. RACHID must give a closing speech at an international congress. What note should she leave?
options: Dental photography is in full evolution, full of opportunities
Dental photography is of no interest

questions.question: Dr. REDA must create a mentoring program in dental photography. What is the main objective?
options: Transmit fundamental skills in dental photography

questions.question: Dr. REDA must create a photographic charter for dental practices. What is the fundamental pillar?
options: Quality of images serving the patient
questions.explanation: Dr. REDA explains: 'The quality of images serving the patient is the pillar of any photographic charter.' Dr. RACHID: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. RACHID must train future mentors in dental photography. What is the first message to convey?

Mentoring is a source of income

questions.question: Dr. REDA must prepare a testimony on his photographic journey. What is the most striking element?

questions.question: Dr. REDA must write an article on the future of dental photography. Which trend should be emphasized?

questions.question: Dr. RACHID must create a photographic quality label for practices. What are the main criteria?

The profession is of no interest
